source_note: The attached PowerWithin PDF is a comprehensive NET/JRF/SET Psychology study compilation. It is not a standalone verified previous-year-question archive, so questions already labelled PYQ-style are kept clearly separate from verified PYQs.

unit_packs.title: Emergence of Psychology
unit_packs.focus: Build the historical and conceptual skeleton first.
unit_packs.rapid: Academic psychology in India; psychological thought; Eastern/Indian psychology; Yoga, Gita, Buddhism, Sufism and related traditions; signs and spirituality.
exam_moves: Link concepts with their defining assumptions
Revise Indian and Western perspectives side by side

unit_packs.title: Research Methodology and Statistics
unit_packs.rapid: Research methodology, paradigms, variables, designs, sampling, measurement, statistics, experimental designs and interpretation.
exam_moves: Identify the design from a scenario
Choose the appropriate statistic/design from the data structure

unit_packs.title: Psychological Testing
unit_packs.rapid: Types of tests, construction, standardization, reliability, validity, norms, test use and interpretation, and attitude scales.
exam_moves: Remember scale characteristics and standardization steps

unit_packs.title: Biological Basis of Behavior
unit_packs.rapid: Physiological psychology, sensory systems, neurons, neural communication and brain organization.
exam_moves: Connect neurotransmitters and systems with behavior

unit_packs.title: Attention, Perception, Learning, Memory and Forgetting
unit_packs.focus: Use process diagrams and comparison tables.
unit_packs.rapid: Attention, perception, illusions, learning processes, conditioning, observational learning, memory and forgetting.
exam_moves: Separate encoding, storage and retrieval explanations

unit_packs.title: Thinking, Intelligence and Creativity
unit_packs.rapid: Language and thought, problem solving and decision making, intelligence theories and assessment, creativity.
exam_moves: Connect creativity with divergent thinking and related models

unit_packs.title: Personality, Motivation, Emotion, Stress and Coping
unit_packs.rapid: Personality theories, motivation, emotion, conflicts, stress, coping and self-regulation.
exam_moves: Differentiate stress models, conflict types and coping strategies

unit_packs.title: Social Psychology
unit_packs.focus: Think in situations, groups and relationships.
unit_packs.rapid: Social perception, attraction, attitudes, persuasion, conformity, obedience, groups, leadership, aggression, prosocial behavior and intergroup processes.
exam_moves: Identify the social process in a vignette
Connect classic studies with the construct they demonstrate

unit_packs.title: Human Development and Interventions
unit_packs.focus: Build lifespan timelines and intervention maps.
unit_packs.rapid: Developmental psychology, developmental theories, psychopathology, psychotherapy, counselling and guidance.
exam_moves: Distinguish disorder features, explanations and interventions

unit_packs.title: Emerging Areas
unit_packs.focus: Revise contemporary applications as connected themes.
unit_packs.rapid: Gender, disability, migration, peace psychology, wellbeing, health psychology and the digital world.
exam_moves: Connect psychological principles with contemporary social issues

study_system.title: 1. Diagnose
study_system.text: Start with a 20-question mixed diagnostic set. Mark every miss as concept gap, confusion, recall failure or careless error.

study_system.title: 2. Learn
study_system.text: Study the micro-topic capsule, source-aligned notes, key terms and the parent syllabus point. Do not jump randomly between books.

study_system.title: 3. Retrieve
study_system.text: Close the notes and explain the concept. Write the definition, two distinguishing features and one example from memory.

study_system.title: 4. Practice
study_system.text: Do PYQ-style and source-based MCQs. Record why each option is right or wrong, not just the final answer.

study_system.title: 5. Schedule
study_system.text: Rate recall as Again, Hard, Good or Easy. The built-in spaced-review queue brings weak topics back automatically.

study_system.title: 6. Interleave
study_system.text: Mix units during revision so recognition does not become the only skill you practise.
